The '''2016 Bespin Power Cube''' (announced as Bespin Power Cube 2016) was a 12-spot cube on 11 June 2016 at Legion Games, 3124 West Hwy 13, Burnsville, Minnesota, organized by [[Mark Walseth]].<ref name="cubeann">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1035384#p1035384 Bespin Power Cube 2016], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (24 May 2016). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122222841/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1037588.html Internet Archive].</ref> The glass trophy is engraved "Rosemount Bespin Cube 2016".<ref name="cubetrophy">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1037588#p1037588 Prize #1], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 June 2016). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122222841/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1037588.html Internet Archive].</ref>
